; Build the selected screen, enable rendering, wait and fade its first palette group in/out, then stop the sound request and disable display through the shared exit.
; Initialize the scrolling text pointer, palette and mirroring; fade in, scroll until Start or the terminal record aborts the helper's caller, then fade out.
; Synchronize one scroll step to the NMI counter, wrap Y at240 while toggling nametable, and prepare another centered text row at each32-pixel boundary. Stage14 suppresses Start cancellation.

; Choose one of16 row destinations from vertical scroll and nametable parity. Scan an FF-terminated character row, calculate padding to32 tiles, and expand paired top/bottom glyphs into RAM. FE discards this call's return address and returns from the scrolling loop; it is deliberately nonlocal control flow.

; Upload both glyph halves with leading/trailing blank padding to a32-tile row destination; advance the text pointer past its FF terminator. Buffers and padding counts must have been prepared by the row builder.

; Draw stage, score, resource counters and timer. Convert the two saved resource counts and remaining time into decimal score with short request/acknowledgement pauses, then award a life when the threshold digit changes. Display identity beyond these mechanics remains tentative.
; Consume the first resource counter one unit at a time, adding one at score digit2 and requesting its redraw. Wait for display acknowledgement plus four NMI ticks between steps.
; Consume the second resource counter one unit at a time, adding one at score digit3 and requesting its redraw with the same pacing.
; Consume timer high units or tens/ones of its low component, adding scaled values into the score digits. Request timer/score redraw after each transfer until both timer bytes are zero.
; Wait for the signed display request acknowledgement, then wait four screen interrupt ticks before the next tally step. Interrupt service must remain enabled.
; Add A to decimal digit X in the seven-digit score array, reduce modulo10 and propagate carries toward lower indices. Caller supplies a valid digit index and bounded increment.
; Draw text records26..28, enable rendering, fade in, wait up to five seconds with Start cancellation, then fade out and exit.
; Reset the music/effect selectors and option row, draw option text, button assignments, difficulty and numeric selections, enable rendering and fade in before polling.
; Request selected-row redraw and wait for acknowledgement. Ignore held input while empty; directional and action bits select the option controls below.
; Down increments the selected option row unless already at row4. Up decrements unless already at row0. The shared refresh path submits request43 after row movement.
; Left on row3 enters the hidden-stage operation. Otherwise control continues through the sound/display pacing path before polling again; exact unlock use remains uncertain.
; Start chooses the highlighted option action; hidden-mode state and the A/B combination gate a special route. The configured button masks and selector bytes remain ordinary RAM state.
; Submit sound request43, fade out and leave the option screen through the shared exit. The request is accepted only while the signed mailbox is empty.
; Dispatch by row: swap action masks1/2, cycle difficulty modulo3, or submit the selected music/effect request. Polling and redraw preserve row state.
